title: Fixed winding numbers: exact pair bounds, graph coercivity, and collision loss
exact_target: Determine when fixed pairwise winding numbers produce periodic three-body solutions by action minimization.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002533 (AIM-PHYSICS-0041). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 4.

status_qualification: The source distinguishes collision-free minimizers from collisional ones and records Lagrange equilateral minimizers when all windings are +1 or all −1. The restricted-case question is restored from its remark; no collision-free conclusion is assumed. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
